Hi Karthik,

As part of our SIG and procurement review we need a short evidence packet from Redwood covering your vulnerability management practices specifically for the environment serving PHI. Two asks from our risk team: 

1) Confirmation of scan cadence and retention for authenticated & unauthenticated scans (network + container image). We need the last 3 scan dates and expected cadence going forward.
2) Formal attestation that CVE ACME-1123 (discovered by our pentest in Aug) was remediated within your stated SLA and the mitigation details (CVE id, patch applied, dates, mitigation owner).

If you can provide a signed attestation PDF and the schedule (or a pointer to a Drive package) by EOD Wednesday 12/2 that would keep us on track.

Also note: our compliance contact Tara Lin (cc: tara@finreg.io) may ask a few clarifying questions after review.

Thank you — let us know if you need a PO or additional vendor forms.

Regards,
Jamie Cole

Hi all — digging in and attaching the draft artifacts we will share. Summary below, details in the attachments and Drive link.

Summary (short):
- Scan cadence: weekly unauthenticated network scans, nightly container image scans in CI, authenticated host scans every two weeks.
- Retention: full scan result retention for 12 months; high-severity findings retained indefinitely in our tracker for audit.
- Last three scan dates (representative):
  * Container image scan: 2026-11-29T02:10:00Z
  * Unauthenticated network scan: 2026-11-27T03:05:00Z
  * Authenticated host scan: 2026-11-16T22:30:00Z
- CVE ACME-1123: root cause was a third-party library (lib-auth v2.1.3). Patch applied: upgraded lib-auth to v2.1.6 and applied runtime mitigation (WAF rule) on 2026-10-15. Remediation ticket: RDW-5823. Remediation owner: SRE Team (owner: Priya Natarajan).
- Remediation SLA: Our target SLA for critical (CVSS 9-10) is 30 days, high (7-8.9) is 60 days. ACME-1123 was categorized as high and remediated in 27 days from disclosure.

Attachments included (drafts):
- vm_scan_schedule_2026Q4.pdf (summary schedule + retention)
- cve_ACME-1123_attestation_draft.pdf (unsigned)
- sla_matrix_vulnerability_management_2026.csv
- Drive link with exported scan logs for the three sample runs: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/VM-Evidence-Pack-ACME

Notes:
- The attestation draft includes the CVE timeline and ticket references; legal team prefers DocuSign for the final signature. If Acme prefers a scanned signed PDF we can escalate.

Jamie — ping me if you want additional artefacts (raw scan exports, ticket RDW-5823 thread).
